newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results week of Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results week of Jan 20.

text.p: company results for week beginning Monday, Jan 20 include:
Profit figures are net before extraordinary items and in
millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd bank, Generale Bank, Gilissen Bankiers, ING, Kempen & Co, Labouchere, Lanschot Bankiers, Strating, Wesselius.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting Jan 27 we are collecting year result forecasts for DSM and IHC Caland.
